entities.name: EMM common procedures
entities.description: Network-initiated procedures including identification, authentication, and security mode control that may be triggered during attach procedure.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure, containing identity information.

entities.name: IMSI
entities.description: International Mobile Subscriber Identity used for subscriber identification.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity used for UE identification.

entities.name: KSI
entities.description: Key Set Identifier used for security context identification.

entities.name: Old GUTI type IE
entities.description: Information element used to determine if a GUTI is native or mapped.

entities.name: EPS mobile identity IE
entities.description: Information element containing UE identity with type indication.

entities.name: Emergency bearer services attach condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is attaching for emergency services or RLOS access.

entities.name: Skip authentication procedure
entities.description: MME behavior to bypass authentication when no EPS security context is available during emergency attach.

relations.description: ATTACH REQUEST message contains IMSI information element.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains GUTI information element.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains KSI information element.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains Old GUTI type IE.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains EPS mobile identity IE.
Old GUTI type IE determines whether EPS mobile identity IE contains native or mapped GUTI.
Emergency attach condition establishes the property of skipping authentication procedure.
EMM common procedure initiation depends on information received in ATTACH REQUEST message.
